[[File:WhirlwindOfDestiny-ATOS.png|thumb|right|200px|Petro demonstrates the maneuver]]
The '''Whirlwind of Destiny''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] technique developed by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] named [[Petro/Legends|Petro]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. It was designed for the user to be flexible, spinning their body and lightsaber around like an actual whirlwind.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Whirlwind of Destiny maneuver was created by a young fan named [[Brendon Lake]] as part of the "Join the Jedi" contest sponsored by [[Hasbro]]. As a reward for winning the contest, the maneuver was animated into the show, and Lake received screen credit for it.
